description: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-conductor-tick.ts, replace the single statement on line 72 which currently reads: if (res) { (t as { status?: string }).status = "dispatched"; dispatched += 1; } — TWO casts are required and the previous attempt failed with TS2339 because only one was widened. First, cast the task to an object type carrying both an optional status string and an optional dispatch_id string. Second, cast res to an object type carrying an optional dispatchId string, because fetchJson is declared to return Promise of unknown and an unknown value has no dispatchId property. Assign "dispatched" to status, assign the dispatchId read from the cast res onto dispatch_id, and still increment dispatched. Keep it one statement. Add no imports, change no other line, and the file must typecheck.
